description: This source file defines the SMSCenter class which manages SMS communication functionalities such as creating receiver lists, retrieving receiver numbers, and sending SMS messages within an ERPNext system. It utilizes frappe framework methods and database queries to manage contacts, leads, employees, and sales persons.

classes.name: SMSCenter
classes.description: A Document-based class in ERPNext for handling SMS center operations such as creating receiver lists and sending messages.

methods.name: create_receiver_list(self)
methods.description: Generates a list of receiver contact information based on criteria such as Customer, Supplier, Sales Partner, Lead, Employee, or Sales Person, and stores it in the receiver_list attribute.

methods.name: get_receiver_nos(self)
methods.description: Parses the receiver_list attribute to extract phone numbers, returning a list of sanitized contact numbers.

methods.name: send_sms(self)
methods.description: Sends SMS messages to the receiver list if a message is provided, utilizing an external send_sms function.
